svg.title: Day 1: on a desk, a tablet on a stand plays a lecture video about the triple bottom line — three overlapping circles for profit, people and planet — while its progress bar fills and a waveform pulses. Sound waves travel to an open spiral notebook where a pen writes outline notes: Triple bottom line, 1 Profit, 2 People, 3 Planet. In front, a signpost points First, Next and Finally; headphones lie on the desk, and a mug steams by the window.

g.text: What is the Triple Bottom Line?
